title: Ya hassan ya hassan
body:
YA HASAN YA HASAN
Kehte the yeh shaahe zaman , Bhai Hasan , bhai Hasan , Karte nahi mujhse sukhan , Bhai Hasan , bhai Hasan
1) Kisne kiya hai khair yeh , kisne diya hai zehr yeh
Neela hai hazrat ka badan
<<MINI>>
Bhai Hasan , bhai Hasan
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Qasim tumhara dilruba , Hai hai yateem ab hogaya , Ghash me hai ba ranj o mehan
<<MINI>>
Bhai Hasan , bhai Hasan
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Zainab ki halat hai buri , Sunte nahi tum ay Aqi , Chillati hai kabse bahen
<<MINI>>
Bhai Hasan , bhai Hasan
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Hai aap par wo sab ayaa'n , Baad aapke ay bhai jaa'n , Guzrenge jo ranj o mahen
<<MINI>>
Bhai Hasan , bhai Hasan
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Bas ek shaheed ek hashr tha , Kehte the jab shahe huda , Ay Qase rabbe zulmenan
<<MINI>>
Bhai Hasan , bhai Hasan
